newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: Gold Fields, Nail talks continue.
newsitem.headline: Gold Fields, Nail talks continue.

text.p: Gold Fields of South Africa Ltd and Driefontein Consolidated Ltd said on Friday that discussions with South African black investment group New Africa Investments Ltd (Nail) were continuing.
The firms advised shareholders to exercise caution if dealing in the groups' shares.
Nail first announced in May that it was in discussions with Gold Fields and its Driefontein unit over acquiring their shareholdings in Asteroid Ltd, which holds 40 percent of GFSA Holdings Ltd.

The deal, if successful, would mark a further big advance for black business in South Africa -- and a significant coup for Nail which already has control of industrial group Johnnies Industrial Corp Ltd.
Gold Fields is the world's third biggest gold producer.
